messages.subject: Plot bitmaps and interactively move points in iPlots
messages.subject_clean: Plot bitmaps and interactively move points in iPlots
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I'm investigating the use of iPlots to interactively input positional data into R. In this case, I have a scan of a hand, and I wish to plot it as a background raster image, take an statistical guess at important locations on the scan (e.g. where the fingertips are), plot these as points (possibly joined by lines), then allow the user to move these points around interactively.

I'm not sure iPlots can be programmed do this easily, but then I'm not sure what other programs that interact with R would work either. Any suggestions

Cheers

Yan

messages.subject: rJava help
messages.body_plain:
I am trying to create a web user interface using RApache. I need to install
rJava packge but I am getting the following error message in Linux(Ubuntu)

RApache Warning/Error!!!

Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'rJava', details: call:
dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) error: unable to load shared library
'/usr/lib/R/site-library/
rJava/libs/rJava.so': libjvm.so: cannot open shared object file: No such
file or directory

but I have the libjvm.so file.

I would really appreciate if you could help me out in this regard.

Sincerely,
Mahesh Yesham

messages.subject: Re: rJava help
messages.body_plain:
On Apr 26, 2011, at 11:50 AM, Mahesh Yesham wrote:

> 
> I am trying to create a web user interface using RApache. I need to install rJava packge but I am getting the following error message in Linux(Ubuntu)
> 
> RApache Warning/Error!!!
> 
> Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'rJava', details: call: dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) error: unable to load shared library '/usr/lib/R/site-library/
> rJava/libs/rJava.so': libjvm.so: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory 
> 
> but I have the libjvm.so file.
> 
> I would really appreciate if you could help me out in this regard.
> 

Well, obviously your environment is not setup correctly. rJava is designed to be run from R so if 
R
library(rJava)
fails then you need to check your R Java configuration -- use R CMD javareconf to re-configure R to match your Java (possibly prepend with sudo).

If that above works but something else doesn't (I don't know how RApache sets up things) then you'll have to make sure that whatever you are using is setting the environment correctly - such as LD_LIBRARY_PATH. The above error suggests that you don't have Java in  LD_LIBRARY_PATH (note that R sets the appropriate paths in the start script but RApache may not -- you'll have to ask on their list).

Cheers,
Simon

messages.subject: Re: plotting question
messages.body_plain:
You can't use Quartz in Rserve (default in png() is to use Quartz) because Apple doesn't support CF calls in forked programs, so the easiest way is to use Cairo package for graphics output (see, for example FastRWeb). So you add library(Cairo) and replace png with CairoPNG.

Cheers,
Simon
